info.title: RawMark API
info.description: RawMark single-user API. Ordinary JSON uses {code,data,message}, with code=0 for success; HTTP semantics are preserved. Login sessions last a fixed 30 days; API tokens retain read/write permissions. Protected APIs accept Bearer authentication only, not Cookies. Files, downloads, events, 204 responses, and OpenAPI are not wrapped. Messages support Accept-Language: en or zh-CN (selected by q weight; default English), and Content-Language reports the selected language; HTTP statuses and business codes do not change. The /settings locale field stores account language (en or zh-CN); null removes the override.

post.description: Only uninitialized instances may set a password. The first successful setup signs in automatically; initialized instances return 409.

get.summary: Application settings (one JSON object shared across devices)

patch.description: Merge top-level keys: supplied values replace existing values, and null removes a key. On success, broadcast a settings event over WebSocket. trashRetentionDays is a nonnegative safe integer (default 30; 0 disables automatic deletion); null restores the default. Retention applies to existing and new recycle-bin entries. Startup and hourly cleanup permanently delete expired entries based on their original deletion times.

post.summary: Download a public image to the note's sibling assets directory
post.description: Accept only public HTTP/HTTPS URLs; validate actual connections and redirects. Do not forward login credentials or use environment proxies. At most 5 requests per redirect chain, 2 download attempts, and a 10-second timeout per attempt; retry only timeouts, 429, and 5xx. Support PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, detected by file signature, up to 50 MB.

post.summary: Import Markdown files or a ZIP vault
post.description: Accept multiple .md files or one ZIP, up to 100 MB total. ZIP imports require a new folder name. The destination directory must exist; conflicts do not overwrite. After extraction and organization: up to 512 MiB, 10,000 entries, 20 MiB per note, and 50 MiB per attachment. Markdown and ZIP filenames must be UTF-8. Preserve ZIP hierarchy; normalize local images into sibling assets directories and rewrite references. Remove migrated originals only when unreferenced; retain other attachments. Do not download external links; return warnings for missing local targets.

dir.description: Destination folder; an empty string means the root

folder.description: New folder name for ZIP import; leave empty for plain Markdown

assets.description: Total retained attachment files, including shared images and other original attachments

put.summary: Replace an existing image in place, preserving its path and references
put.description: The multipart file extension must match the target image. Do not create new files; maximum 50 MB. The old image is not sent to the recycle bin.

400.description: Invalid path, empty file, or mismatched extension

post.summary: Export original Markdown and local attachments
post.description: Accept a nonempty path list. Return .md for a single note without attachments; folders, multiple selections, or notes with attachments return ZIP. ZIP preserves vault-relative paths. Do not download external resources or follow unselected notes. Missing attachments or invalid paths return errors. This POST does not modify data and accepts read-only tokens.

get.description: Login sessions only. Count regular-file bytes in the data directory and actual vault, deduplicating nested roots and ignoring internal symlinks.
